blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed all three tracked deployments on 2026-08-08. Ethereum 0xbe370ad45d44eb45174c4ec60b88839fef32c077 is a direct, non-proxy MakerDAO Dai-source token: transferFrom requires holder allowance, authorized wards may mint, and no pause, blacklist, freeze, seizure, or arbitrary holder-burn path exists. Polygon 0xe75220cb014dfb2d354bb59be26d7458bb8d0706 still resolved to exact-match PhtOFTUpgradeable implementation 0x98210a4b34eafd668838108c99ad13a2b4340618 at block 91674718. Its current implementation adds no transfer restriction to LayerZero OFT ERC-20 behavior, but owner 0xc6f1cfa1b5840e5afe56f7b7ef3c52c3bcda06c5 can replace that implementation through UUPS. Tron TXdN5fvFjCdqjWJRvWmBzSRLBN7JLYmmrs remained material and unresolved: at block 85182167, Tronscan returned name=PhtOFT, is_proxy=false, verify_status=0, and a method map containing transfer, transferFrom, send, lzReceive, setPeer, and setDelegate but no visible pause/freeze selector; owner() returned EOA hex 0xfb99a0af49941ec1ca2fc726be1e287f4c70f5ee (base58 TYuYeSqxFF5CjtpFjv46nWWeiAWjVe2iY4). Because the Tron runtime is unverified, selector absence cannot prove that its transfer path lacks a fallback or indirect holder restriction. The prior inherited verdict had no resolvable variantOf or mintAuthority.inheritedFrom parent and was therefore structurally invalid for the V9 freeze adapter. It is corrected to possible, which honestly preserves the unresolved material Tron deployment rather than asserting false.

oracleRisk.summary: Five debt-bearing Ethereum ilks were retained. Three divide a Chainlink stablecoin/USD numerator by an owner-set APACX PHP/USD denominator without contract-enforced freshness, while two zero-ceiling legacy ilks with outstanding debt use owner-set APACX feeds directly; liquidation is immediate through independent Dutch auctions.

branchApplicability.rationale: The live ILK Registry enumerated seven independently parameterized Ethereum branches at finalized block 25531795. USDT-A, cPHP-A, ApcxUSDT-A, demoUSDT-A, and USDC-A all retained positive normalized Vat debt and are reviewed below; cPHP-A and demoUSDT-A are retained despite zero debt ceilings. dUSDT-A and dUSDT2-A had both zero normalized debt and zero ceilings and are excluded from current debt-bearing coverage, although their joins, Clips, and Dog configuration remained live and callable.

branches.label: USDT-A
branches.summary: Debt-bearing USDT branch dividing a Chainlink USDT/USD numerator by an owner-set APACX PHP/USD denominator; neither the ratio feed nor Pip enforces source freshness.

feeds.provider: Chainlink numerator and owner-set APACX denominator through ratio DataFeed and Pip
feeds.path: Pip 0xf68658dEc2Ed65D347031852038661Cb572D1B4E -> ratio DataFeed 0x587a9590a78A72c86796bA9C2A369E81268d4284 -> Chainlink USDT/USD 0x3E7d1eAB13ad0104d2750B8863b489D65364e32D divided by owner-set APACX PHP/USD 0x6829AAaFa90739946C62a13eE4A9c5d99baC7aF8

branches.fallbackBehavior: No fallback or stored last-good value. The ratio feed combines a Chainlink numerator with an owner-set PHP/USD denominator; the Pip rejects only a negative result and does not inspect timestamps. The documented 24-hour update policy is not contract-enforced.

collateralParameters.note: Vat normalized debt Art was 6,939.383963243451574983 and the branch debt ceiling was positive. Dog applies a 1% liquidation penalty.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller may immediately bark an unsafe vault through Dog, starting its independent Clip Dutch auction at 120% of the reference price; the auction may reset after 7,200 seconds or after price falls below 75% of its start.
branches.backstop: Auction proceeds cancel debt through Vat/Vow accounting. At the observation block, Vow queued bad debt for 561,600 seconds and required its configured 50 PHT sump before the live Flop could auction APCX recapitalization; Flop was connected to Vow and authorized to mint and burn APCX.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: End was live and ward-cageable. ESM required 10 raw APCX, but its collected Sum and APCX total supply were both zero, so no holder-funded ESM trigger capacity existed at the observation block. Without an authorized cage, residual debt remains in Vat/Vow for the conditional auction path.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PHT's canonical Ethereum CDP issuance is separated from its LayerZero bridge machinery. The Ethereum MyOFTAdapter wraps the canonical PHT token and is controlled by the same EOA that owns the Polygon UUPS OFT; Polygon is a verified LayerZero representation with no resolved timelock or multisig for implementation replacement. APACX identifies Tron as a bridged PhtOFT, but its runtime, endpoint, peer, delegate, and mint/burn semantics remain unverified. Polygon and Ethereum peer configuration is asymmetric, so no single conserved route is proven and the aggregate bridge tier remains opaque-or-unknown.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-4 (lead dai-makerdao); FIX2-17 boundary migration

routes.reviewNote: PHT on Ethereum is the canonical native-issuance deployment. The DaiJoin adapter 0x4bd328fd071b03e157d0a89de199d9e005d71057 is warded on PHT (wards=1), and the live Maker-style Vat path supplies collateral/debt-ceiling-bounded issuance; canonical-side bridge adapter powers are reviewed separately below.

APACX identifies Polygon as a PHT bridge representation. At Polygon block 92141033, the proxy resolved to exact implementation 0x98210a4b34eafd668838108c99ad13a2b4340618 with LayerZero EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c; owner 0xc6f1cfa1b5840e5afe56f7b7ef3c52c3bcda06c5 can replace the OFT logic through UUPS without a resolved timelock or multisig. Polygon points to the Ethereum adapter, but the adapter's Polygon EID peer is zero, so a currently usable bilateral route is not fully proven.

routes.reviewNote: APACX identifies Ethereum↔Tron PHT movement through LayerZero, so Tron is treated as a bridge representation sourced from canonical Ethereum. At Tron block 85415139, Tronscan identified TXdN5fvFjCdqjWJRvWmBzSRLBN7JLYmmrs as an unverified, non-proxy PhtOFT and owner() returned TYuYeSqxFF5CjtpFjv46nWWeiAWjVe2iY4. The current endpoint, peer, delegate, lzReceive mint behavior, send burn behavior, and any hidden owner-controlled upgrade/direct-mint path remain unresolved; the route stays opaque-or-unknown rather than receiving a favorable verified tier.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: MyOFTAdapter inherits LayerZero OFTAdapter and returns the canonical PHT token; its source-side debit and destination credit are bridge accounting, not a second native PHT issuer.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Ethereum block 25770390, peers(30420) returned 0xed9206f7c98d4e0c947dd339b8d1ff188c40c3fe and peers(30109) returned zero. Polygon currently points to this adapter at EID 30101, so the Ethereum/Polygon peer state is asymmetric; the owner can change peers and the LayerZero delegate.

Owner-controlled peer/delegate and route-configuration powers are bridge administration; no adapter implementation-upgrade authority was separately evidenced.

The owner can replace the bridge representation logic without a resolved delay or multisig and can alter peer/delegate configuration.

controls.label: APACX PHT Tron PhtOFT owner
controls.capDescription: The Tron PhtOFT is a native LayerZero OFT: token() returns the contract itself, approvalRequired() returns false, and endpoint() returns LayerZero Endpoint V2 0x0af59750d5db5460e5d89e268c474d5f7407c061, while the deployed bytecode carries no mint, burn, upgrade, or proxiable selector. Bridge mint and burn therefore run only through the authenticated LayerZero path under no supply cap; the current peer table was not enumerated.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: APACX identifies Ethereum↔Tron movement through LayerZero OFT, but the unverified Tron runtime does not prove a supply-conserving burn/mint invariant or a lockbox.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Tron block 85862190 on 2026-09-01, owner() returned 0xfb99a0af49941ec1ca2fc726be1e287f4c70f5ee (TYuYeSqxFF5CjtpFjv46nWWeiAWjVe2iY4) and endpoint() returned LayerZero Endpoint V2 0x0af59750d5db5460e5d89e268c474d5f7407c061, so the route's messaging endpoint is resolved. The current peer table and delegate were still not enumerated, so an authenticated remote is not claimed.
routeChecks.caps: At Tron block 85862190 on 2026-09-01, cap(), maxSupply(), mintCap(), supplyCap(), and mintingLimit() all returned empty on TXdN5fvFjCdqjWJRvWmBzSRLBN7JLYmmrs, token() returned the contract itself, and approvalRequired() returned false, so it is a native LayerZero OFT with no supply ceiling. Its deployed bytecode contains no mint(address,uint256), burn(address,uint256), upgradeTo(address), upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes), or proxiableUUID() selector, so there is no owner-controlled direct-mint or upgrade path and no cap bounds an authenticated lzReceive mint.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Tron block 85862190 on 2026-09-01, the TronGrid contract record for the non-proxy PhtOFT exposed the standard LayerZero OFT ABI, and its deployed bytecode contains setPeer, setDelegate, setEnforcedOptions, setMsgInspector, setPreCrime, transferOwnership, and renounceOwnership but no mint, burn, upgradeTo, upgradeToAndCall, or proxiableUUID selector. The owner therefore controls peer, delegate, enforced-option, and ownership configuration with no upgrade or direct-mint path.
